items.conditions: Promotional article by a Shenzhen SMT shop (深圳市小铭工业互联网有限公司, Nov 2026 pricing basis). Notes the 'point' definition varies (per pad / per part / part + pin weighting) and the same board quoted 0.008 vs 0.015 by two factories. One-off fees: engineering 200-800/款, stencil 100-300/张, start-up 500-1500/次.
items.quote: 常见区间大致在 0.006~0.02 元/点之间，差异来自点数口径、封装难度、批量大小、是否含检测。低于这个区间往往意味着检测环节被压缩，高于这个区间要问清贵在哪。

items.conditions: Shanghai SMT shop article. Point counting: 0402-1210 R/C = 1 point; below 0402 = 2 points; transistors 1.5; tantalum/electrolytic/inductor 2 (large = 4); SOP/QFP 3 pins = 1 point; QFN/BGA 2 pins = 1 point; headers 3 pins = 1 point (min 3). Per-point fee includes red glue, solder paste and AOI. Small batch (<1000 pcs or order <¥1000) adds start-up ¥400-2000; <100 pcs engineering ¥800-3000.
items.volumeOrPrototype: general; batch orders priced points x unit price with no start-up fee

notes: Firecrawl credits ran out mid-task (reset 2026-11-26 08:02 UTC); later pages were read with WebFetch (a summariser that returned the quoted lines) and the Guanghong PDF was extracted locally with pdftotext. Several Chinese pages refused (HTTP 503/521: csdn.net coating article, adspcba.com, oyessmt.com, smtnet ICT PDF). All per-point/per-joint prices found are online or small-shop list prices for prototype/small-batch, consumer-grade work; they are an UPPER-ish bound for volume on unit price but exclude automotive extras (IATF documentation, traceability, 100% AOI/X-ray, PPAP). FX: £1 = ¥8.88 (caller's); USD converted at an ASSUMED £1 = $1.25 (not sourced). Comparison for this board (2,054 placements; pad count not given - estimated ~4,800 pads = ~1,950 two-pad passives x2 + 2 x 292 BGA balls + ~300 other IC pads; points by the yijun rule ~2,400): SMT placement+paste+AOI+changeover in our model = £10.05 (¥89) vs Huaqiu ¥0.01/pad x 4,800 = ¥48 (£5.4); JLCPCB $0.0012/joint x 4,800 = $5.76 (~£4.6); market range ¥0.006-0.02/point x 2,400-4,800 = ¥14-96 (£1.6-10.8). Our £8.70 placement alone = ¥0.0376 per placement = ~¥0.016 per pad. THT: ours £1.76 (insert+selective) vs Huaqiu 68 x ¥0.10 = ¥6.8 (£0.77) / JLC 68 x $0.012-0.0164 = $0.82-1.12 (£0.65-0.89). Coating: ours £4.70 (¥41.7 = ¥0.0246/cm2 over 1,698 cm2) vs JLC prototype ¥0.03 x 849 cm2 = ¥25.5 one face (£2.87) or ¥50.9 if both faces charged (£5.73). X-ray: ours £0.41 vs JLC $0.082 x 2 = $0.16 (£0.13) at its top tier, Huaqiu ¥3 x 2 = ¥6 (£0.68) small batch. Depanel: ours £0.17 (¥1.5) vs Huaqiu ¥0.50 (£0.06), JLC ¥2/panel (£0.23 if 1-up). Packaging: ours £0.60 vs JLC ESD bag ¥1 + divider 849 cm2 x ¥0.002 = ¥2.70 (£0.30). EMS margins are % of revenue INCLUDING components, so they cannot be compared directly with our +10% SG&A +8% profit on conversion and 6% on material without the BOM value; as a check, listed Chinese EMS automotive gross margins are 5.6% (Guanghong 2024) and 8.8% (USI 2025), net margins 3-4% of revenue, EMS industry net 2.6% (2024).
